purpose: Teach: 侵攻/搾取/転落/談話/快楽/湾岸/丸山/セックス

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、サイバー侵攻の防御を強化しております
lines.style: Level, official tone. Measured delivery without flourish. Sitting upright, shoulders steady. The voice of someone accustomed to public statements.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、労働者を搾取する違法業者を警察、摘発されたんですね
lines.en: So the police worked to crack down on that illegal labor exploitation ring in this case?
lines.style: Genuinely curious, not challenging. Leans forward slightly as he thinks through the connection. Respectful rhythm, checking his understanding.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、転落事故の原因究明に取り組みます
lines.en: We're committing to a thorough investigation of the fall accident.
lines.style: Clear, professional delivery. Slight emphasis on 'thorough.' No hurry in the pacing. The tone of someone explaining procedure, not deflecting.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者の談話を警察、慎重に分析されたんですね
lines.en: So you analyzed the suspect's statement very carefully in this investigation?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Soft, almost tentative—not accusatory, genuinely wanting to understand. The rhythm of someone working through implications.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、薬物の快楽依存防止に力を入れます
lines.en: We're putting real effort into preventing substance addiction in the community.
lines.style: Steady conviction without preaching. The emphasis sits on 'real effort'—showing this isn't just policy, it's a priority. Calm but firm.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、湾岸地区の警備、警察、強化されたんですね
lines.en: So the police strengthened security in the waterfront district in response to this situation?
lines.style: Observant, connecting dots aloud. Quiet respect in the voice. Gentle curiosity, not interrogation. A small nod in the rhythm.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、丸山氏のお話を伺うべく訪問しました
lines.en: I visited Mr. Maruyama to hear his account directly.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, methodical. The voice of someone documenting steps taken. Steady pace, no apology in the delivery. Professional distance maintained.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、未成年セックス被害について警察、慎重対応ですね
lines.en: So the police are approaching the minor sexual abuse cases with real care and thoughtfulness.
lines.style: Soft, respectful. The voice drops slightly—this is serious ground. No irony. Genuine appreciation mixed with the weight of the subject matter. Closing with quiet sincerity.
